imp_lines.text: I was sent to learn the SENDING. Nobody sends US anything.
Wheee — oh. I landed. That's the hard bit.
My rocket went sideways. Into a wall. Twice.
No invitations, no guests! Hee hee hee!
planned_use: unchanged: the steal story beat is outside the contest

imp_lines.text: I was sent to learn the DANCING. Watch my twirl!
Whoops! I'm dizzy. Dizzy is a kind of dancing.
Spin, spin, spin, FALL. That's the hard part.
The music box! No music, no party, hee hee!
planned_use: unchanged: the steal story beat is outside the contest

imp_lines.text: I was sent to learn the BOUNCING. Put 'em up!
Good one! Best two out of three? No? Okay.
Left! Right! ...which one is left again?
The shiny belt! Champions get invited to things!
planned_use: unchanged: the steal story beat is outside the contest

imp_lines.text: I was sent to learn the SWEETS. I am very good at sweets.
Oof! My tummy hurts anyway. Too many gumdrops.
One for the bag, two for me. That's how it works!
Candy! Every party needs candy and now WE have it!
planned_use: unchanged: the steal story beat is outside the contest

imp_lines.text: Two taps will stop me!
Crew! Back to me! Hee hee!
I was sent to learn the CAKE. Don't mind me, I'm learning.
Fine! The cake needed more sugar anyway!
Flour goes in the bowl... or on my head. Either way!
Mine now! A birthday needs a cake and I HAVE one!
planned_use: unchanged: the steal story beat is outside the contest

imp_lines.text: I was sent to learn the SEARCHING. Where is everything?
Aww. It didn't even fit on my horns.
I looked under here. And here. Nothing! Detecting is hard.
The sparkly crown! Now everyone will look at ME!
planned_use: unchanged: the steal story beat is outside the contest

imp_lines.text: I was sent to learn the MENDING. Something of mine is torn too.
Ouch! Can you fix ME after?
Bandage on... bandage off. Bandage on my nose?
I'm taking the patient! He likes me better!
planned_use: unchanged: the steal story beat is outside the contest

imp_lines.text: I was sent to learn the FEEDING. What do piggies even eat?
Blegh! I got mud in my mouth.
I planted a rock. Nothing grew. Farming is tricky!
Snack time! This picnic is OUR picnic now!
planned_use: unchanged: the steal story beat is outside the contest

imp_lines.text: I was sent to learn the MAGIC. Abraca-... something.
Ta-daa! That was supposed to happen. Really.
I made it disappear! ...where did it go? Uh oh.
Now you see the show, now you DON'T!
planned_use: unchanged: the steal story beat is outside the contest

imp_lines.text: I was sent to learn the QUIET. I am bad at quiet.
Sorry! Was that too loud? Was it?
I tried to be quiet. Sorry! Sorry!
The star mobile! Ours is just a sock on a string!
planned_use: unchanged: the steal story beat is outside the contest

imp_lines.text: I was sent to learn the DECORATING. Ours is very grey.
Bonk! Now I'm a different colour.
I painted my hands. And the wall. And a bit of the floor.
Pretty colours! Our party needs pretty too!
planned_use: unchanged: the steal story beat is outside the contest

imp_lines.text: I learned a new song. Listen to me sing!
My ears! Okay okay, you sing it.
Was that the right note? It felt like a note.
No microphone, no singing! Our band is better anyway!
planned_use: unchanged: the steal story beat is outside the contest

imp_lines.text: I was sent to learn the FAST. I am already fast!
Pit stop! Pit stop! I need a pit stop!
Whoa whoa WHOA — how do you stop this thing?
Catch me! You won't! ...you might!
planned_use: unchanged: the steal story beat is outside the contest

imp_lines.text: I found it first! Watch the glowing answer, then solve the same mystery with your sparkle memory!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Your cake needs my special ingredients! Socks and worms! Hee hee!

new_lines.speaker: roshan
new_lines.text: The imp is putting yucky things on my cake! Tap them off and finish the toppings!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Special delivery! Yum yum!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Race you to the sparkles! Mine are purple!

new_lines.speaker: roshan
new_lines.text: Find my gold sparkles before the imp finds his purple ones!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Twirl-off! Three big spins. Ready? Spin!

new_lines.speaker: roshan
new_lines.text: Twirl around the music box three times!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Candy race! First to give every friend a sweet wins!

new_lines.speaker: roshan
new_lines.text: Give a candy to every friend before the imp does!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Bandage race! Wrap all three paws!

new_lines.speaker: roshan
new_lines.text: Wrap every sore paw, gentle and quick!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Feeding race! My piggies eat first!

new_lines.speaker: roshan
new_lines.text: Pull back and toss four veggies to the hungry piggy!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: First to six! Put 'em up!

new_lines.speaker: roshan
new_lines.text: Punch when the star shines, and guard when he winds up!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Watch my hats! Can you find Lamb-a'?

new_lines.speaker: roshan
new_lines.text: Watch the hat with Lamb-a', then tap it when it stops!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Paint-off! First to finish their picture wins!

new_lines.speaker: roshan
new_lines.text: Paint the whole picture before the imp finishes his!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Rocket race! Patch the leaks and blast off first!

new_lines.speaker: roshan
new_lines.text: Patch every leak, then hold to blast off!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Two laps! First one home wins! Go, go, go!

new_lines.speaker: roshan
new_lines.text: Swipe to steer through the coral gates!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Sing-off! Sing my song back to me!

new_lines.speaker: roshan
new_lines.text: Listen to the imp's song, then sing it back!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Hee hee! Party time! Let's make some noise!

new_lines.speaker: roshan
new_lines.text: Shh! Tap the noisy imps before they wake the babies!

new_lines.speaker: roshan
new_lines.text: Shhh! Babies are sleeping!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Hee hee! Wake-up party! Again, again!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: That geode is mine! Race you to the crystals!

new_lines.speaker: roshan
new_lines.text: Tap the cracks on your side, then pull it open before the imp does!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Hello! I'm the field guide! Rocks are my favourite snack!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Ow! My toe! Who put a toe there?

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Aww! Can I just look at the sparkly crystals?

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: My turn to be the teacher! Can you catch my silly mistakes?

new_lines.speaker: roshan
new_lines.text: The imp is teaching it wrong! Tap the right answer to fix it!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Hello, class! I'm the new teacher! I know everything! I think.

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Easy peasy, lemon squeezy! This one comes next!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: One, two, three... eleventy-twelve! It's this many!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Two plus one makes... a banana! No wait. This many!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Look! These two are twins! Same, same, same!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: You're the real teacher! I'll go sit in the silly corner.

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Which smells the worst? Farts, garbage, old diapers, or rotten cheese?

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: I know! This pretty rose! Pee-yew!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Pee-yew! That's so stinky! I'm gonna faint!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Hee hee! Tricked you! Roses smell nice!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Which is the loudest? A burp, a big drum, a roaring lion, or a fire truck?

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Easy! This teeny tiny mouse! Squeak!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Ow, my ears! That's so loud!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Hee hee! Tricked you! Mice are super quiet!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Which is the biggest? A whale, an elephant, a dinosaur, or a castle?

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: I know! This itty bitty ant! Look at its muscles!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Whoa! That's so big! I feel teeny!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Hee hee! Tricked you! Ants are tiny!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Which is the stickiest? Honey, bubble gum, a booger, or slime?

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: This fluffy feather! It sticks to everything!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Eww! My fingers are stuck together!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Hee hee! Tricked you! Feathers float away!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Which is the coldest? Ice cream, a snowman, an ice cube, or a penguin?

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Brrr! The sun! It's freezing!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Brrr! My toes are frozen!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Hee hee! Tricked you! The sun is hot!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Which is the slowest? A snail, a turtle, a sloth, or a slug?

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Zoom! This rocket is soooo slow!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Sooo... slooow... Yaaawn!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Hee hee! Tricked you! Rockets go zoom!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Which is the squishiest? Jelly, a marshmallow, mud, or a whoopee cushion?

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: This hard rock! Squishy squishy!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Squish! So squishy!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Hee hee! Tricked you! Rocks are hard!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Which is the yuckiest to eat? A mud pie, a wiggly worm, a stinky sock, or soap?

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Yuck! This cupcake!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Bleh! Yucky yucky yuck!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Hee hee! Tricked you! Cupcakes are yummy!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: I won! I won! Let's play again!

new_lines.speaker: roshan
new_lines.text: Again! I can do it this time!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Oops! You fixed it! My brain is full of bubbles!

new_lines.speaker: imp
new_lines.text: Hee hee! Tricked you!
